label: Display
pick_label: The screen is black or shows nothing

d_start.text: Is the blank screen a laptop's built-in screen, or a separate monitor connected to a computer?
d_start.why: The checks are different for each, so I need to know which one to start with.

d_lap_bright.title: Check brightness and wake the laptop
d_lap_bright.do: Press the brightness-up key on your keyboard several times. Then press any key or tap the touchpad to wake the laptop.
d_lap_bright.why: Brightness can be at its lowest, or the laptop may be asleep with the screen off while the power light is still on.
d_lap_bright.expect: If this was the cause, the picture comes back right away.

d_lap_ext.text: Do you have an external monitor or TV and an HDMI cable you can use for a quick test?
d_lap_ext.why: An external screen tells us whether the laptop is producing a picture at all.

d_lap_ext_test.title: Test with an external monitor
d_lap_ext_test.do: Connect the monitor or TV to the laptop's HDMI port, turn it on, and select the matching input. Then press the Windows key + P and choose 'Duplicate'.
d_lap_ext_test.why: If the external screen works, the laptop is producing a picture and the problem is likely its own screen.
d_lap_ext_test.expect: The external screen may take a few seconds to show the desktop.
d_lap_ext_test.fixed_label: The external screen shows the desktop
d_lap_ext_test.not_fixed_label: The external screen is blank too

d_lap_light.title: Look for a faint picture
d_lap_light.do: Dim the room lights. Shine a phone flashlight at an angle on the screen and look closely for a faint Windows login or desktop.
d_lap_light.why: If you can faintly see the picture, the laptop is working but the screen's backlight is not lighting it.
d_lap_light.expect: You would only see a very dark outline if the backlight is the problem.

d_power.title: Do a power reset
d_power.do: Hold the power button for 10 seconds to turn the laptop off. Unplug the charger and any USB devices. Hold the power button for 30 seconds, then plug in only the charger and turn it on.
d_power.why: Holding the power button drains leftover electricity, which can clear a stuck power or display state.
d_power.expect: The laptop may start more slowly than usual and the fan may spin up briefly.

d_mon_cable.title: Check the monitor cable and input
d_mon_cable.do: Turn the monitor on. Make sure both ends of the video cable (HDMI, DisplayPort or VGA) are firmly plugged in. Use the monitor's input button to select the matching input.
d_mon_cable.why: A loose cable or the wrong input is the most common reason for a blank monitor.
d_mon_cable.expect: The monitor may show 'No Signal' first, then the picture.

d_mon_signal.text: Does the monitor show a 'No Signal' message?
d_mon_signal.why: 'No Signal' means the monitor works but is not receiving a picture from the computer.

options.label: No, it shows nothing at all

d_power_desk.title: Do a power reset on the computer
d_power_desk.do: Turn the computer off, unplug its power cable, and hold the computer's power button for 30 seconds. Plug the cable back in and turn it on.
d_power_desk.why: This clears leftover electricity that can leave the computer stuck without sending a picture.
d_power_desk.expect: The computer may take a little longer to start.

d_mon_other.title: Test the monitor on another device
d_mon_other.do: Connect the same monitor and cable to another computer or laptop and check whether it shows a picture.
d_mon_other.why: This tells us whether the problem is the monitor or the computer.
d_mon_other.expect: The monitor shows the other device's screen if it is working.
d_mon_other.fixed_label: The monitor works on another device
d_mon_other.not_fixed_label: The monitor is blank on the other device too

d_done_settings.cause: The brightness was too low, or the laptop was asleep with the screen off.
d_done_settings.learn: A laptop can keep its power light on while the display is off. Sleep mode and very low brightness both look like a dead screen.

d_done_power.cause: A temporary power or display state was stuck.
d_done_power.learn: A power reset drains residual charge from the hardware so it can start fresh, a bit like closing and reopening an app that froze.

d_done_cable.cause: A loose cable or the wrong monitor input.
d_done_cable.learn: A monitor only shows what arrives on the input it is set to, and the cable must be firmly connected to carry the video signal.

d_pro_panel.reason: The laptop seems to produce a picture, so the problem may be the laptop's own screen, backlight or internal cable. Checking those means opening the laptop.
causes: Loose or damaged internal display cable

d_pro_general.reason: The safe checks did not fix the problem. Further diagnosis needs hardware tools or opening the device.

d_pro_monitor.reason: The monitor stays blank on another device too, so the monitor itself may need repair or replacement.
causes: Faulty cable (try a different cable if you have one)
